guidelines: Use Oswald exclusively for headings, numbers, and stats to give a heavy-weight athletic feel.
Use Manrope for all body copy, descriptions, and UI labels for readability.
Headings must be uppercase to maintain the tactical, high-energy gym aesthetic.
Never use pure black or white. Use the defined base colors.
Volt Lime (#D4FF00) is the kinetic trigger. Use it sparingly for primary CTAs, active states, and progress bars. Text on Volt Lime MUST be inverse (#09090B) for contrast.
Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Rely on solid colors and 1px borders.

spacing_and_layout.container: w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6
guidelines: Generous spacing: Use p-4 to p-6 inside cards. Use gap-4 to gap-6 between elements.
Mobile-First: Everything defaults to single column. Expand to grids on md and lg screens.
High Density Dashboard Grid: For stats and tracking, use tight gaps (gap-4) and utilize every pixel. Ensure cards stretch using h-full.
Never center everything. Asymmetry and left-alignment create a more technical, professional feel.

cards.accent_bar: Cards for specific exercises or workouts should have a 4px left border using the respective muscle group color (e.g., border-l-4 border-[#FF4D4D]).

Inicio.layout: Hero section with athlete image overlay (bg-black/50), quick workouts in accordions grouped by level, bento grid for stats.

Calendario.layout: Monthly/Weekly view calendar, colored dots for workout types.

Historial.layout: Vertical list of session cards. Each card shows name, date, volume, duration.

Ayuda.layout: Exercise library with search and filters.
features: Exercise cards with left accent bar

Cuenta.layout: Centered form container for auth, standard layout for profile.

motion.interactions: Use active:scale-95 on buttons and clickable cards. Use framer-motion for smooth list mounting and accordion expanding.
motion.transitions: transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out for hover states. Avoid 'transition: all' globally in CSS.

icons_and_assets.guidelines: Use Lucide icons with stroke-width 2 or 2.5 for a bold, athletic look. Size icons appropriately (w-5 h-5 standard, w-6 h-6 for mobile nav).

hero_backgrounds.description: Athlete lifting barbell in dark gym. Use with bg-black/50 overlay.
Shirtless man lifting weights in dark environment. Use for motivational banners.

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure Tailwind with the exact colors defined above in tailwind.config.js.
Add Oswald and Manrope from Google Fonts to index.html.
Remove ANY mention of the word 'blink' from the codebase, UI, variables, or comments.
Use Shadcn UI components but strip them of the default 'Vercel' look. Apply the tactical #141414 surface and #27272A border to cards, dialogs, inputs, etc.
For the calendar, build a functional grid or use a robust date picker component. Add colored dots representing workout types.
For charts in 'Progreso', use recharts. Ensure the lines/bars match the primary accent (#D4FF00) and muscle group colors.
For the bottom navigation on mobile, ensure it has padding-bottom to account for safe areas (pb-safe).
All cards must have a 1px solid border (#27272A) and no soft shadows. This is a tactical UI, not a soft SaaS.
Apply `data-testid` attributes to all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs or modals.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
NEVER use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image URLs.
